before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = '/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(path)
grouped = df.groupby('年月', as_index=False)['平均待ち時間'].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(grouped['年月'], grouped['平均待ち時間'], marker='o', linewidth=2)
ax.set_title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間')
ax.set_xlabel('年月')
ax.set_ylabel('平均待ち時間')
ax.set_ylim(0, grouped['平均待ち時間'].max() * 1.1)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
